scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.js scripts/judge-links*.mjs scripts/hosting-cache.test.mjs scripts/agent-merge*.mjs scripts/notify-decisions.test.mjs scripts/firestore-rules.test.mjs scripts/*m3*.mjs scripts/check-definition-draft.mjs scripts/run-emulators*.mjs scripts/browser-processes.test.mjs scripts/source-upload.test.mjs && pnpm -r lint
scripts.test: node --test scripts/judge-links.test.mjs && pnpm test:source-upload && pnpm test:hosting-cache && pnpm test:emulator-runner && pnpm test:agent-merge && pnpm test:notify-decisions && pnpm test:firestore-rules && pnpm test:design-mocks && pnpm test:m3-score && pnpm -r test

scripts.test:manual-assignments:browser: pnpm --filter server... build && node scripts/run-emulators.mjs --config-from-env --project demo-kadai-hisho --only auth,firestore "node packages/web/tests/run-plans-browser.mjs --manual-assignments"

scripts.test:plans:emulator: node scripts/run-emulators.mjs --config-from-env --project demo-kadai-hisho --only auth,firestore "pnpm --filter @kadai-hisho/core build && RUN_PLAN_EMULATOR_TESTS=1 pnpm --filter server exec vitest run --testTimeout=20000 tests/plans.emulator.test.ts"

scripts.test:sharing:emulator: node scripts/run-emulators.mjs --project demo-kadai-hisho --only auth,firestore "pnpm --filter server... build && RUN_SHARING_EMULATOR_TESTS=1 pnpm --filter web exec vitest run --testTimeout=20000 tests/sharing.emulator.test.ts"

scripts.test:sessions:emulator: node scripts/run-emulators.mjs --project demo-kadai-hisho --only auth,firestore "pnpm --filter server... build && RUN_SESSION_EMULATOR_TESTS=1 pnpm --filter web exec vitest run tests/session.emulator.test.ts"

scripts.test:demo-announcements:emulator: pnpm build && node scripts/run-emulators.mjs --project demo-kadai-hisho --only auth,firestore "node packages/web/tests/run-demo-announcements-browser.mjs"
